name: grid-pixelate-wipe
title: Grid Pixelate Wipe
description: Transition effect where the screen dissolves into a grid of squares that fade out with staggered timing — use between scenes. A composition of its own: mount it over both scenes once for each cut, in a host 1.2 s long that starts 0.6 s before the cut; the frame is fully covered at 0.6 s, where the cut goes.
